title: Data Broker Removal Request Letter Template
metaDescription: Free template to request data removal from brokers. Protect your privacy with our customizable letter format for opting out of data collection.
description: Take control of your personal information with our professional letter template designed to request data removal from brokers. This customizable template helps you formally demand the deletion of your personal data and opt out of future data collection practices.

sections.heading: Subject Line
sections.content: Subject: Formal Request for Personal Data Deletion and Opt-Out Under [CCPA/GDPR/Applicable Privacy Law]

sections.heading: Opening Statement
sections.content:
Dear Data Protection Officer,

I am writing to formally request the complete deletion of all personal information your company has collected, stored, or processed about me. This request is made under my rights pursuant to [the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA)/General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR)/applicable state privacy laws].

sections.heading: Personal Information Details
sections.content:
Please delete all records associated with the following information:

• Full Name: [Your Full Name]
• Email Addresses: [List all email addresses]
• Phone Numbers: [List all phone numbers]
• Current and Previous Addresses: [List all addresses]
• Date of Birth: [Your date of birth]
• Any other personal identifiers in your database

I request that you search your entire database using all variations of my name, email addresses, phone numbers, and addresses listed above.

sections.heading: Deletion Request
sections.content:
Specifically, I request that you:

1. Delete all personal information you have collected about me from any source
2. Remove my information from all databases, including backup systems
3. Stop any ongoing collection of my personal data
4. Cease selling or sharing my personal information with third parties
5. Add my information to your suppression/do-not-collect list to prevent future data collection
6. Notify any third parties to whom you have sold or shared my data of this deletion request

sections.heading: Legal Basis and Rights
sections.content:
This request is made under my legal right to data deletion. I understand that you are required by law to:

• Respond to this request within [30/45] days as required by applicable privacy regulations
• Provide confirmation of the data deletion
• Honor this request without charging any fees
• Verify my identity through reasonable means before processing this request

If you cannot delete certain information due to legal obligations, please specify what information will be retained and the legal basis for retention.

sections.heading: Identity Verification
sections.content:
To verify my identity, I am providing the following information: [Include any reasonable verification information, but avoid providing additional sensitive data]. If you require additional verification, please contact me using the information provided above.

I understand that providing false information in this request may be subject to legal penalties.

placeholders.label: Identity Verification Details
placeholders.defaultValue: Last four digits of phone number: 4567

sections.heading: Response Requirements
sections.content:
Please confirm receipt of this request within 5 business days and provide:

1. Confirmation that you have located and deleted all my personal information
2. Details of any information that cannot be deleted and the legal reason why
3. Confirmation that my information has been added to your suppression list
4. Assurance that no further data collection will occur

Please send your response to: [Your Email Address] or [Your Mailing Address]

sections.heading: Closing Statement
sections.content:
I expect full compliance with this request within the timeframe required by law. If you fail to respond appropriately, I reserve the right to file complaints with relevant regulatory authorities and pursue other legal remedies available to me.

Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.

Sincerely,
[Your Signature]
[Your Printed Name]
[Date]

useCases: Requesting data deletion from major data brokers like Acxiom, LexisNexis, or Epsilon
Opting out of people search engines and background check websites
Following up on ignored privacy requests with formal documentation
Protecting personal information after identity theft or privacy breach
Reducing digital footprint before job searches or life changes
Compliance with court orders requiring data removal
Protecting family members' privacy, especially children's information
